routines.cleanup: One active fast-write at a time, all columns added before actual finalization and close/reload. Actual EK claims close before scratch removal after captured status reset; failures retain claims for retry. WASM temporary buffers free in finally; C NULL-padding allocations free on both failures/success. Internal wkindx cache is intentionally retained for reuse and bounded by typed1million-row guard; fixture clears its private cache to verify allocator accounting. Both harnesses reset/kclear and dispose per case.
routines.tolerance: Existing1e-12 absolute-or-relative comparison retained. Authored doubles include exact binary fractions, large finite values and1e-7 (well above absolute tolerance); independent literal assertions use exact stored values. Int32 extrema and all counts/flags/indices/strings/diagnostics compare exactly in literal tests. No bytes or metadata fields are dropped to hide differences.

findings.summary: Original cases did not distinguish the per-routine vector/NULL/error/state boundaries; ekffld error coverage included only a workflow-label failure.

findings.summary: Matching caller array lengths did not establish actual segment storage. A controlled compiled C consumer observed all three writers forwarding row1 for an actual row3 segment; CSPICE derives counts from the actual segment and fixed-size schema. Finalization lacked a length argument.
findings.repair: Validate actual segment metadata using ekssum_c, also used by CSPICE writers themselves, before any downstream array access. Check real fixed entry sizes and per-row sizes; add nrows to the private finalization ABI and reject truncated pointer backing. Public ABI unchanged. Actual full-write recovery proves rejected input does not prevent later valid data. Regenerate both WASM outputs through owning N0067/Emscripten3.1.74 build.

findings.summary: Original cases did not distinguish the per-routine vector/NULL/error/state boundaries; ekffld error coverage included only a workflow-label failure.

findings.summary: Matching caller array lengths did not establish actual segment storage. A controlled compiled C consumer observed all three writers forwarding row1 for an actual row3 segment; CSPICE derives counts from the actual segment and fixed-size schema. Finalization lacked a length argument.
findings.repair: Validate actual segment metadata using ekssum_c, also used by CSPICE writers themselves, before any downstream array access. Check real fixed entry sizes and per-row sizes; add nrows to the private finalization ABI and reject truncated pointer backing. Public ABI unchanged. Actual full-write recovery proves rejected input does not prevent later valid data. Regenerate both WASM outputs through owning N0067/Emscripten3.1.74 build.

findings.summary: Empty/all-NULL data could fail or hit N0067 character-wrapper flag storage shorter than nrows. Minimal two-byte slots read six single letters back as blanks in an independent actual CSPICE probe. SpiceyPy6.0.3 independently sizes packed backing by len(str), unsuitable for UTF-8 byte widths/empty arrays.
findings.repair: Require a minimum3-byte internal stride and pad zero-size variable NULL rows with one ignored blank per row, preserving literal NULL results. Fault both C temporary allocations with no net leaked storage and actual retry; all37 WASM wrapper positions pass. Oracle invokes the same actual CSPICE entrypoint through SpiceyPy ctypes with explicit byte packing and its actual error checker; no synthetic result substitutes the operation.
